get_config_zoedepth: get the ZoeDepth model config for training or inference mode with optional dataset and overwrite kwargs
get_model_config: get the model config JSON file for a named model with optional version and inheritance support
flatten_config_dict: flatten a nested config dictionary into a single level dict skipping specified keys
split_combined_args: split combined double underscore arguments like __n_bins__lr=256;0.001 into individual key value pairs
change_dataset_config: change the dataset in an existing config by updating it with the new dataset configuration
